title: What is agentic coding?

body.text: Agentic coding is having the AI
carry out multiple steps continuously and automatically
— not just writing one piece of code, but planning, writing, testing, and fixing until the job is done.

example: "Build a REST API for authentication with JWT, middleware, and complete tests"

title: Plan the task clearly

body.text: clear scope, measurable output, and key constraints
— tell Codex what you want, what not to do, and what stack the project uses.

example: "Refactor the auth module to TypeScript, don't change the API interface, use Jest for tests"

options.text: The AI carries out multiple steps continuously until the job is done

question: What's the most important info when writing a task for Codex?

options.text: The name of the responsible developer
A clear scope, measurable output, and constraints
The date and time the task was created

question: What kind of work should you use agentic coding for?

options.text: Fixing a typo in a document
Multi-step work, like building a new feature with tests

question: For agentic coding to work well, what should you start with?

options.text: Plan the task clearly before the AI starts
Having the AI carry out multiple steps per the defined plan
Typing code one character at a time
